name: Chicken Enchiladas
desc: Corn tortillas dipped in green chile sauce, rolled with chicken and Colby jack

ingredients.raw: 1 (19 oz) can green chile enchilada sauce

steps: In a bowl, combine the shredded chicken, 1 cup of the cheese, the chopped green chiles, salt and pepper.
In a small skillet, bring the enchilada sauce to a boil, then remove from heat.
Dip each tortilla into the hot sauce for a few seconds to soften it.
Spoon 1/3 cup of the chicken mixture and 2 tbsp sour cream down the centre of each tortilla. A sandwich bag with the corner cut off makes the sour cream easy to pipe.
Roll each tortilla and place seam side down in an 8x8 or 9x9 inch baking dish.
Pour the remaining sauce over the top and scatter over the rest of the cheese.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and the cheese has melted.
